provenance.construction: Z7-invariant (quasi-cyclic) non-CSS stabilizer code: 21 qubits in 3 orbits of 7 (qubit 7*b + g, b in 0..2, g in Z7) and 14 independent generators of weight 6 in 2 orbits of 7, generated by shifting Y0 X1 Z2 Z6 X7 Y13 and X9 Y10 Z16 Z17 Z19 X20 under g -> (g + t) mod 7. Every qubit has check degree 4. Found by lazy SAT search (CaDiCaL 1.9.5 via PySAT) with upfront distinct-syndrome constraints for weights 1-2 and lazy weight-3 logical cuts; single-layer 2D layout (r = 4.0) found by simulated annealing. Not CSS under any single-qubit Clifford.
provenance.notes: Distance: exhaustive enumeration over all Pauli operators of weights 1, 2, and 3 finds zero nontrivial logicals, and an independent HiGHS MILP over all 14 logical sectors confirms d = 4 exactly (147 weight-4 nontrivial logicals exist, including the stored witness X1 Y3 Z5 Z6). All 16,383 non-identity stabilizer elements have weight >= 6 (14 of weight 6), so the code is nondegenerate. Filed with confidence upper_bound because the board's server certifier does not yet minimize Pauli weight. Not CSS under any single-qubit Clifford (checked by verify/qldpc_verify.py). Literature novelty is not claimed; without a check-weight cap, codetables.de reaches [[21,7,5]].
